prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial artwork. Premium tactile paper, limestone, ceramic and crafted miniature illustration with cobalt blue, vermilion red and warm ivory. Refined composition, soft directional studio light, controlled shadows and fine material detail. Wide landscape, essential objects inside central safe crop. No typography, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, statistical charts or collage. A single continuous miniature landscape connects a small caravan of three camels on an ivory desert ridge at left with a modern cobalt cargo ship carrying red and ivory containers in a deep blue sea at right. A fine red thread links the two across a sculptural coastline, symbolic coexistence of eras, not a literal historical transformation. Wide 1200x630 cover.
